notes.title: Hangry Early Access Release Sept 27th
notes.content: [p]Time to book your table reservations. We are excited to announce that Hangry will be released on Early Access Saturday September 27th, 2025! It will release with a promo sale that will last for the duration of Steam's Autumn sale.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus with your main course, you get Hangry's first comic book "First Course" for FREE![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Learn about the origins of Hangry and how he joined Chef Goutra and got himself involved in the shady and delicious world the food underground.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/56dd71d3fbea3e892ccff1a4aee9e7a21683b316.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Try out the DEMO which is available right now. You get access to the game's tutorial and first mission! You can continue your demo save file on the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Add to your Wishlist today![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601510/HANGRY/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/9d6e266753f8c9a4596bc6ee9205606786d0801a.png[/img]

Getting hungry? We know Hangry is. The delicious smell of piping hot food is filling the diner, not to mention the rising tension among its patrons. But it's nothing Hangry can't handle.

Hangry's Early Access is being made fresh for order, dine-in or take-out. So stand by, and get ready to dive in teeth and claws first!

The "First Course" comic book DLC will be available once Early Access is released.

notes.title: Get the Hangry Comic Book "First Course" on Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png[/img]

Available when the game releases, comes Hangry's first comic, "First Course"! Experience a moment in the blue hunter's history and how the ferocious creature met the up and coming chef, Goutra. Will be available as DLC.

notes.title: Hangry Playtest Sign-Ups Concluded
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone you joined in on the Hangry Playtest! We have accumulated lots of good feedback and are working to improve the next release of the game.

We are no longer accepting new playtest sign-ups, however if you joined the playtest prior, you can still play the game for a couple more days!

notes.title: Hangry Playtest Available for Limited Time!
notes.content: Hangry Playtest by Request is available now for a limited time! We would love to hear your feedback on the game so far!

notes.title: God of War trades deities for diets in new RPG about fighting food
notes.content:
Sometimes a videogame must be seen to be believed, and Hangry is one such case. Blending the hack-and-slash combat of games like Devil May Cry and God of War with the wacky worldbuilding of Psychonauts, this action RPG tasks you with traveling the galaxy and fighting dangerous culinary creatures that just so happen to look like food. Just don't eat the goods, please.
